snippet.title: Your Turn To Thrive - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
After 2 years of development, we’re very excited to release a single scene showcase for Your Turn to Thrive! You can play it in browser on itchio, download it (Windows and Mac versions available), or watch the full scene here. The browser version currently has some display issues on mobile and audio bugs, so we recommend playing it on desktop at this time. In the months ahead we will release a more comprehensive demo featuring the first 6 scenes of YTTT Chapter 1!

Your Turn To Thrive is a YTTD fan game taking place 6 months after massacre ending with Nao Egokoro as protagonist!

Play Your Turn To Thrive
